entries.title: Deposited crambin: 1CRN
entries.description: Three prepared representations of the same deposited protein: atomic sticks, residue beads and a schematic envelope.
entries.provenance: Pinned RCSB PDB/CCD CC0 inputs, source lock and shared-coordinate packages in animlib fixtures.
limitations: A static deposited conformer does not supply a folding trajectory.
The envelope is schematic; CA beads are residues, not atoms.

entries.title: RCSB deposited molecular structures
entries.description: Research and publish a selected protein or nucleic structure through the existing PDB preparation path.
entries.provenance: Host downloads fixed RCSB PDB/CCD endpoints and records hash-checked cached snapshots and source selections.
limitations: Requires a researched supported four-character PDB accession and available publication tool.
Returned protein traces and nucleotide geometry do not reconstruct assemblies, dynamics, or missing atoms.

entries.title: Illustrative peptide rig and staging
entries.description: Original component templates, stable residue identities and prescribed torsions for staged coil formation and packing.
entries.provenance: Original CC0-1.0 sequence and staging; component geometry derives from pinned CC0 CCD inputs.
limitations: Authored motion is neither a measured folding trajectory nor an energy simulation.
Packing has no general collision-avoidance guarantee.

entries.title: Nucleic mechanism inputs
entries.description: Portable explicit sequence, pairing and schedule inputs for transcription and RNA processing examples.
entries.provenance: Versioned original illustrative inputs and preparation records bundled with animlib demonstrations.
limitations: Illustrative sequences and kinematic schedules are not deposited reaction measurements.
Scene VM cannot fetch these files; the host must prepare the selected input.

entries.title: Prepared native geometry and image packages
entries.description: Reusable immutable model/image packages with content hashes, provenance and explicit resource ownership.
entries.provenance: Package manifests retain original or upstream provenance, source hashes and binary dependency identities.
limitations: Native package registry and production GLB publication are distinct delivery paths.
Only explicitly selected assets and their dependencies should be loaded.
